answer: Work-slot deposit burn: 40 slots open each epoch; claiming one locks a 150 POA deposit, burned if peer audit rejects the work. Crossing the ridge to paid work means staking first, so a sybil farm pays 150 POA per fake: 1,000 fakes cost 150,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and keeps the reward. A whisper of bad work travels fast: three auditors from a grove of veterans check every slot; a failed audit burns it and bars it for 20 epochs.
